VBO:0200726.summary: Veterinarian Linda Simon describes the Jack Chi as affectionate, outgoing and energetic, keen on scent games and food puzzles. This Jack Russell–Chihuahua cross can learn quickly yet lose focus during training. She notes that prey drive varies: some individuals readily chase birds or squirrels.
VBO:0200726.shortDescription: A lively Jack Russell–Chihuahua cross, described by veterinarian Linda Simon as affectionate and keen on games.

sources.title: Jack Chi — veterinarian Linda Simon, DogZone original guide
